trigger: upstream README (LAMDA-NeSy/ChinaTravel) started linking a new HF sandbox dataset (commit b071db2, 2026-08-17); checking it surfaced a separate, already-linked dataset repo change instead
what_this_is: a post-competition identity check, not a promotable measurement -- the competition is over and no submission slot is spent

newly_linked_sandbox.diff_vs_v1_v2_bundled_sandbox: 27 files differ (database_en/*, matching accommodations/attractions/restaurants csvs) -- postdates the graded runs (DATA_QUALITY_FIXES_2026_08)
newly_linked_sandbox.diff_vs_v1_bundled_sandbox_vs_v2_bundled: 0 files differ across all three -- same snapshot used for both graded submissions and still tracked here
newly_linked_sandbox.conclusion: environment/world data only; not the held-out test set; must not be swapped in to reproduce a historical score

newly_published_test_set.self_described_as: the official Phase 2 competition test split (dataset repo's own PHASE2_RELEASE_NOTES.md)

identity_check.method: replayed the unmodified fabiundstefan_v1.zip and fabiundstefan_v2.zip archives (each including its own bundled, pre-fix sandbox database, confirmed byte-identical to this repo's tracked chinatravel/environment/database_en) against the newly materialized split via each archive's own agent_env/scripts/solve_script_with_harness.py --harness tpc and eval_tpc.py
identity_check.materializer: scripts/materialize_official_heldout_test.py (evaluation-only; raw CSV and per-query JSON never committed, hf_* .gitignore rule)
identity_check.reading: both reproduce within ~1 point of the organizer-reported score, in the same direction, from identical code and byte-identical environment data. Attributed to solve_phase2.py's wall-clock-budget-driven triage/repair/polish passes (multi-minute real-time budgets that converge differently depending on host speed/load), not to a different or partially-overlapping query population -- a population mismatch would produce an unrelated score on two independent submissions, not a consistent ~1-point same-direction offset on both.
identity_check.conclusion: high confidence this is the actual organizer held-out test set, its oracle now public post-competition

what_is_still_unknown: whether the organizers' own scoring host would reproduce these exact numbers if re-run (their SGLang/Qwen host is not reachable from here; that endpoint is irrelevant to this deterministic solver anyway)

whether the +0.365 / +0.840 residual is fully explained by budget-pass timing or partly by an unrelated minor drift (e.g. floating point, library version) -- not investigated further since this is retrospective
